rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the person’s individual behavior or experience seems eccentric or odd.

example.english: Their daily habits are really idiosyncratic: they skip breakfast and only cook at midnight.
example.traditional: 佢啲生活習慣真係好古怪，朝早唔食嘢，反而半夜先煮飯。

rows.note: Use this for someone’s distinctive personal way of doing things, especially when it is not necessarily negative.

example.english: Ming has an idiosyncratic way of making coffee, even with a fixed method for adding milk.
example.traditional: 阿明沖咖啡有自己一套，連落幾多奶都有固定方法。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 cung1 gaa3 fe1 jau5 zi6 gei2 jat1 tou3 lin4 lok6 gei2 do1 naai5 dou1 jau5 gu3 ding6 fong1 faat3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that the person’s qualities or style are uniquely their own rather than specifically odd.

example.english: Their painting style is very idiosyncratic; you can tell at a glance that it is their work.
example.traditional: 佢畫畫嘅風格好獨特，一睇就知係佢嘅作品。
